sources.title: Architecture graph for ReadyArt/Serenity-31B-v1.1 | hfviewer
sources.snippet: ReadyArt/Serenity-31B-v1.1 architecture at a glance ReadyArt/Serenity-31B-v1.1 is a model (gemma4_text architecture). It uses 60 transformer layers, a hidden size of 5,376, and 32 query heads with 16 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use an intermediate size of 21,504.
